visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a large, square, pale yellow pudding with a glossy orange-brown caramel top being lifted by a metal spatula. It is carefully lowered into a white paper cup filled with iced milk tea. The lighting is bright and even, emphasizing the smooth texture of the dessert. (2) The scene transitions to a stainless steel steamer where two metal trays of set pudding are being cooked. Subsequently, a large rectangular block of caramel pudding is shown in a metal tray, demonstrating its firm yet jiggly structure. The background is a clean, industrial kitchen setting. (3) Detailed close-up of a stainless steel bowl where numerous bright orange egg yolks are being whisked by a hand wearing a purple glove. White milk is then poured from a plastic pitcher into the egg mixture. The camera remains static to capture the fluid motion of the ingredients blending. (4) The custard mixture is poured through a fine mesh metal sieve into a large tray that already contains a layer of dark brown caramel syrup at the bottom. This emphasizes the filtration process to ensure a smooth final texture. The lighting is consistent with a bright indoor prep area. (5) A hand uses a metal spatula to cut the large pudding slab into uniform square cubes. Then, a butane torch is used to apply direct flame to the tops of the individual pudding squares, causing the sugar to bubble and caramelize into a deep brown crust. Small sparks and smoke are visible. (6) Fresh milk tea is poured into a white cup, and one of the caramelized pudding squares is placed on top. The cup features a blue circular logo with a mountain and river design. The drink is held against a background of lush green leaves, suggesting an outdoor garden or street-side setting. (7) Another beverage is introduced: plum green tea with jelly. Scenes show brownish, translucent plum jelly being sliced into cubes on a white cutting board. The cubes are then scooped into a cup. A dried plum is dropped into the tea as it is poured, creating small splashes. (8) The camera pans across multiple cups being filled with different types of tea, including a dark red black tea and a light golden green tea. A large plastic bottle of tea is also showcased, highlighting different serving sizes. The branding '山大和茶鋪' is clearly visible on all containers. (9) The final scene shows the exterior of the beverage shop '山大和茶鋪' during the day. It features a clean white sign with blue text and a logo. A customer in a white shirt and backpack stands at the service counter. Green trees and a modern building facade are visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly, energetic male narrator introduces the video over an upbeat electronic pop background track with a steady 4/4 drum beat. His voice is clear and authoritative, characterized by high articulation and moderate pitch variability. There is a faint sound of liquid being stirred in the mix. (2) The narration continues at a steady conversational pace, describing the ingredients. Short, subtle metallic clicks and rustling sounds are heard, corresponding to the use of kitchen tools. The background music maintains its consistent energy, featuring bright synthesizer pads and a rhythmic electronic bassline. (3) A distinct sizzling sound occurs as the blowtorch is used, layered briefly over the narration. The vocal tone remains positive and enthusiastic. The ambient noise floor is extremely low, suggesting a studio-produced voiceover laid over the scene. (4) More liquid pouring and splashing sound effects are audible, highlighting the preparation of the milk tea and plum juice. The music's percussive elements remain prominent, providing a driving rhythm for the fast-paced visual editing. The narrator's speech density is high, providing continuous information about the drinks. (5) The final phase features a cheerful sign-off from the narrator with a slight rise in vocal arousal. The background music reaches its conclusion with a standard fade. A very faint urban ambient hum can be heard during the exterior shot, though it is largely masked by the music and vocal track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Showcase -> Manufacturing Process -> Variation -> Shop Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for the beverage brand '山大和茶鋪' in Kaohsiung. It focuses on the artisanal quality of their handmade puddings and unique plum jelly drinks. By showing the step-by-step preparation process—including whisking eggs, steaming, and torching—it emphasizes freshness and craftsmanship to attract food lovers and tea enthusiasts.
